title: Design macro daily-brief live-operation preflight and Owner authorization gates
objective: Produce a fail-closed, Solana-only live-operation design for the approved macro daily brief. Define Dune saved-query allowlisting, aggregate-only storage, a 400-day retention policy, complete-UTC-day scheduling at D+1 14:00 UTC, test-destination delivery gating, retries, idempotency, monitoring, and an authorization matrix. This task designs and documents the preflight only; it must not execute Dune, write a database, schedule a job, or deliver a report.
owner_authorization: Owner authorizes task-card and design creation only. The operating policy is: Dune saved-query allowlist only with no dynamic SQL; aggregate-only database storage; aggregate, manifest, and rendered-report retention for 400 days with raw provider payloads retained for 0 days by default; complete UTC report day with first run at D+1 14:00 UTC; delivery starts only at an Owner-specified test chat/destination and expands only after seven GREEN runs; retries at 5m, 15m, and 60m with a UTC-day idempotency key; alert on execution failure, coverage insufficiency, delivery failure, and version drift. Dune credentials, concrete database target, concrete delivery/alert targets, live execution, database writes, scheduling, and delivery remain unauthorized until separately supplied or approved in a later execution task.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Dune queries or use Dune API/CLI; do not access keys, cookies, credentials, external APIs, or live payloads.
Do not create or modify database migrations, repositories, collectors, schedulers, delivery implementations, Lark/Feishu publishing, CLI entrypoints, or runtime configuration.
Do not treat placeholder database, test-delivery, or alert destinations as resolved. They must be recorded as PARK/Owner decision required.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood. Robinhood remains explicitly Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial_coverage; Four.meme remains PARK.
Do not modify CA creator facts, holder cleaning, creator rules, Dev behavior, wallet-cluster rules, or transaction-wallet quality rules.

Do not calculate or claim real liquidity retention, token-to-pool linkage, external-pool conversion, drawdown/survival, sentiment values, real users, buyers, demand, smart money, net flows, wallet quality, or a token trading signal.
